$description: Source spec for tokens/primitive/color.tokens.json. Each ramp declares a hue and a chroma rule; scripts/generate-ramps.js expands it into per-step OKLCH values with sRGB hex fallbacks. Edit this (and the anchor) to re-skin a design system, then run `npm run generate:ramps`.

ramps.name: neutral
ramps.description: Near-achromatic tonal ramp with a faint cool tint (OKLCH hue 250, chroma 0.006). Step number = OKLCH lightness x 100.

ramps.name: brand
ramps.description: Brand tonal ramp derived from the anchor (SAX logo blue #005A9C, OKLCH hue 249.6). The anchor is a maximal-chroma blue, so the curve follows the sRGB gamut ceiling: min(0.17, gamut maximum at each lightness). Step number = OKLCH lightness x 100.

anchor.description: Exact SAX logo brand color. The ramp's hue and chroma curve are calibrated through this point; it sits on the sRGB gamut boundary between steps 40 and 50.

ramps.name: success
ramps.description: Success tonal ramp (OKLCH hue 150). Chroma is gamut-proportional: min(0.17, 0.85 x sRGB gamut maximum at each lightness). Step number = OKLCH lightness x 100.

ramps.name: warning
ramps.description: Warning tonal ramp (OKLCH hue 85). Chroma is gamut-proportional: min(0.17, 0.85 x sRGB gamut maximum at each lightness). Step number = OKLCH lightness x 100.

ramps.name: danger
ramps.description: Danger tonal ramp (OKLCH hue 25). Chroma is gamut-proportional: min(0.17, 0.85 x sRGB gamut maximum at each lightness). Step number = OKLCH lightness x 100.
